text.en: Cassius, Quests and Rewards

note.en: Play a 0, 1 and 2 cost card to recieve Straight

body.en:
Cassius's gimmick is his Quests from Popper
Popper has a pool of 4 Quests with different conditions required to finish
Quest 0: Every 3 0 cost cards played, you get Triple 0
Quest 1: Every 3 1 cost cards played, you get Triple 1
Full House: Play a card from every member of your team, recieve Full House
MAX QUESTS YOU CAN COMPLETE PER TURN ARE 3

note.en: Hardest condition to finish, but 3 Moral can be very strong

body.en:
Quest 0 is very easily spammable, so you can finish quests very easily for Moral
Quest 1 required minimum of 3 AP per complete but its reward is okay now
Full House: Relatively easy condition to finish and also good reward.
